args.prompt: A sprite kit of 8 boss projectiles for a cute 2D pixel art game arranged in a clean grid of 4 columns by 2 rows, each fully visible, well separated with plenty of empty space, none touching, all the same size. TOP ROW: 4 animation frames of a dark violet and magenta spiky energy orb, a ball with an angry little face and small pointy spikes rotating a bit each frame, crackling with dark purple sparks (a BAD projectile). BOTTOM ROW: 4 animation frames of a glowing golden-and-pink star-shaped candy orb with a sparkling cute star face and a soft glow, twinkling a little different each frame (a GOOD projectile). 16-bit Super Nintendo style pixel art, chunky hard square pixels, a clean 1-pixel dark plum outline, flat cel shading, no anti-aliasing, no text, no labels. Solid flat cyan background, nothing else.
